text: Purina (Nestle Purina PetCare) is the pet-food division of Nestle S.A., the SIX-listed Swiss food group. Nestle has a broad institutional shareholder base with no controlling or state shareholder, so the St. Louis CITY SC front sponsorship is private corporate money. Human-rights exposure comes from Nestle's own supply-chain record rather than any state owner.
